decisions.reason: The board-chain topology does not change the connector types, signals, pin-order policy, or unresolved physical pin numbering in this Requirement.
The power-distribution topology does not alter the I2C cable, clock, pull-up, or series-resistor configuration.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the INA219 position and total downstream 3.3V current coverage, so no additional or edited Event is required.
The normal power-board-to-main-board chain does not change the existing USB-only activation condition, LDO source, rating, or standalone powered scope.
The source uses existing interboard connectors but does not add, remove, or reclassify any connector in the main-board inventory.
Placing the INA219 downstream of the Schottky diodes does not change the OR-ing method, participating sources, or source-selection behavior.
The board-chain power path does not change the battery-charge indicator, CHGLED connector, resistor, or population requirements.
The distribution topology does not change the switched 5V boost enable control, output capacity, or powered-load definition.
The downstream board-chain arrangement does not alter the battery connector, battery voltage range, or connection to the AXP2101.
The source does not change the LEDs' 5V supply, GPIO-controlled switching, or required data-level shifting.
The power-chain and current-monitor placement do not change the requirement for local main-board decoupling capacitors.
The source does not affect panel-control connectors, GPIO assignments, reset wiring, touch inputs, or button placement.
